integrity.proof_basis: Exhaustive standard-library exact compatibility-clique search with proved coloring-based pruning; explicit codeword construction.
integrity.secondary_check: Independently assembled SciPy binary shadow-packing model for lengths seven, eight and nine; numerical corroboration, not the proof.

scientific_limitations: All exact maxima are for binary indexed linear words with maximum constant-symbol run of two and length at most nine.
The first-gap assertion concerns ordinary congruence classes modulo n+1, not every possible modified or generalized checksum scheme.
Historical priority is qualified; unindexed finite enumerations may contain this value.
title: The first strict VT-syndrome gap for binary single-deletion codes with run ceiling two
